name: Cyreni's Razors
inspire:
Inspire a number of friendly fighters equal to the battle round at the beginning of each combat phase.

Uninspire
At the start of the round, Uninspire each friendly fighter.

reactions.name: Hammertide
reactions.rulesText: You can use this ability if your leader ({icon:leader}) is on the battlefield and has no Charge tokens. Draw a straight line from your leader's ({icon:leader}) hex that passes through the centre of an adjacent hex and goes all the way to the edge of the battlefield. Inflict 1 damage on the first enemy fighter that line crosses and give that fighter a Stagger token. The line ends if it touches a blocked hex.

abilities.name: Deadly Riposte
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after an enemy fighter's failed Attack that targeted a friendly Thrall ({icon:thrall}).
abilities.flavorText: The eyeless Namarti fight with an eerie, deadly grace.
abilities.rulesText: That Thrall's weapons have Cleave ({icon:cleave}) and Ensnare ({icon:ensnare}) during the next turn while that enemy fighter is the target of an Attack.

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ink
abilities.trigger: Use this immediately after an enemy fighter's failed Attack that targeted a friendly Cephanyr.
abilities.flavorText: Cephanyr is well versed at escaping in a burst of black ink.
abilities.rulesText: Push Cephanyr a number of hexes equal to the battle round.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.trigger: Use this in a Power step.
abilities.flavorText: The Idoneth seek out strong souls to sustain their people - and it is never wise to catch their eye...
abilities.rulesText: Pick an Inspired enemy fighter. Then your opponent must pick one of the following: Uninspire that fighter, or you can draw Power cards equal to the battle round. You can only use this ability once per game.

playstyle: Four Idoneth reavers with modest Health and single-dice saves who rely on reach-2 weapons and average Move rather than raw toughness, with Cephanyr flying over obstacles. The warband grows stronger as the game goes on, Inspiring one more fighter each battle round, while its leader's Hammertide blasts a line across the board to chip and Stagger the first enemy it crosses. Failed attacks are punished, arming Thralls with Cleave and Ensnare or letting Cephanyr ink-dash away, so the Razors win by baiting attacks and overwhelming foes late.
